label: spp 2 crosswalk hydro
definition: spp-42: SPP coal supply-class crosswalk (EIA-923 rank -> COAL_PRB/COAL_LIGNITE, zero-LP inert) + 2025 hydro vintage repair (EIA-923 2024 backfill + EIA-930 NG:WAT monthly level pin, every year); otherwise the spp-1 baseline recipe
market_story: No mechanism moves any class in this keeper: every offer band is 1.0 and no floor, bridge or adder is armed. The two changes are measured inputs. Coal now scores as COAL_PRB (27 PRB-by-rail plants) and COAL_LIGNITE (the two mine-mouth lignite plants) because that is how SPP burns coal per EIA-923; the dispatch is byte-identical to the first keeper. Hydro in 2025 is the measured EIA-930 water year (8.8 TWh, ~3 % of energy) instead of the preliminary EIA-923 vintage's 0.02 TWh, so the six VOLL hours the missing water produced are gone except one South hour behind the bound N->S corridor.
